mimicry_basis: Streptococcal M protein shares antibody- and T-cell-reactive epitopes with alpha-helical coiled-coil host proteins (myosin tropomyosin vimentin)
evidence_level: Strong - decades of antibody and T-cell cross-reactivity studies
source: Cunningham MW et al.; Guilherme L et al. Circulation 1995

mimicry_basis: Bacterial lipooligosaccharide structurally mimics human nerve gangliosides triggering cross-reactive anti-ganglioside antibodies
evidence_level: Strong - confirmed in animal models (rabbit) and patient serology
source: Yamada M et al. PNAS 2004; Godschalk PC et al. Infect Immun 2007

mimicry_basis: EBV nuclear antigen EBNA1 contains peptide sequences with structural/antibody cross-reactivity to central nervous system autoantigens
evidence_level: Moderate-Strong - large cohort studies + antibody cross-reactivity data
source: Bjornevik K et al. Science 2022; Lanz TV et al. Nature 2022

mimicry_basis: Viral capsid protein P2-C shares a short amino acid sequence with glutamic acid decarboxylase (GAD65) expressed on insulin-producing cells
evidence_level: Moderate - sequence homology and T-cell studies
source: Kaufman DL et al.; Honeyman MC et al. Diabetes literature

mimicry_basis: Chronic H. pylori infection associated with antibodies cross-reactive to gastric proton pump components
evidence_level: Moderate - clinical and serological association studies
source: Amedei A et al.; D'Elios MM et al. immunology literature

human_target: Glycolipid antigens on erythrocytes / neural tissue
mimicry_basis: Shared glycolipid/glycan epitopes between bacterial membrane and host cell surface glycolipids drive cross-reactive antibody production
evidence_level: Moderate - documented in post-infectious case series
source: Narita M. Front Microbiol reviews on M. pneumoniae extrapulmonary disease
